sloka: ततह् शून्याम् गतजनाम् वसुधाम् पादपैः सह ।त्वमेका शाधि दुर्वृत्ता प्रजानामहिते स्थिता ॥२-३७-२८॥
transliteration: tatah śūnyām gatajanām vasudhām pādapaiḥ saha ।tvamekā śādhi durvṛttā prajānāmahite sthitā ॥2-37-28॥

translations.english: Intent upon doing harm to the people with your vile behaviour, you alone rule this kingdom full of trees and deserted by men.
